question: Should `agents.defaults.mediaMaxMb` be enforced for locally materialized `video_generate` and `music_generate` references, matching the existing `image_generate` contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically consistent, but it deliberately makes an existing configured setting reject inputs that previously passed through, so maintainers must accept that upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept consistent enforcement
options.body: Treat the existing setting as the shared cap for all locally materialized generation references across image, video, and music tools.

options.title: Preserve legacy acceptance
options.body: Do not land this enforcement until maintainers define a separate reference-input policy or configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Accept consistent enforcement
recommendation.body: Treat the existing setting as the shared cap for all locally materialized generation references across image, video, and music tools.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work owns substantial `video_generate` reference and delivery semantics nearest to this compatibility choice.
